title: The bridge at Sungai Kecil
paragraphs: The bamboo bridge at Sungai Kecil had stood for many years, but the heavy rains that season left it {{1}}. Children from the village had to walk an extra hour to reach school. Pak Hadi, the {{2}} carpenter in the village, offered to rebuild it.

He needed strong bamboo and many helpers, so he asked each family for a small {{3}}. At first, some neighbours spoke {{4}} about the plan. They said that the river would destroy any new bridge within a year.

Pak Hadi did not argue. Instead, he {{5}} a small model and showed how the new supports would stand on higher ground. His calm explanation was {{6}}, and soon even the doubtful neighbours were carrying bamboo. Within three weeks, the bridge was finished.
